summary: This note covers The Hunger Games: Mockingjay – Part 2, the final film in the franchise, and its release and box office performance. It was released November 20, 2015 in the United States in several formats, including 3D, and the only film in the series widely released in 3D. The film opened to $102.7 million in North America, fell below expectations, and grossed over $653 million worldwide, the lowest of the four franchise films but still a commercial success.
one_line: Release details and box office performance of The Hunger Games: Mockingjay – Part 2, the 2015 final film in the franchise.
key_facts: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay – Part 2 was released on November 20, 2015 in the United States.
The film was released in the United States in 2D and IMAX.
Internationally, Mockingjay – Part 2 was released in 2D, 3D, RealD Cinema, and IMAX 3D in select territories.
Mockingjay – Part 2 is the only film in the series widely released in 3D.
The film opened with a $102.7 million gross during its opening weekend in North America.
The opening weekend fell below expectations both internationally and domestically.
Mockingjay – Part 2 had the sixth-biggest opening in 2015.
The film held at number one at the international box office for four consecutive weekends.
The film grossed over $653 million worldwide.
Mockingjay – Part 2 was the ninth highest-grossing film of 2015.
Mockingjay – Part 2 was the lowest-grossing of the four films in the franchise.
Despite its lower gross, the film was still described as a commercial success.
